why_it_matters.text: A medicine sold as Serc, used in the UK and Europe for the vertigo of Meniere's disease. It is a close chemical relative of histamine.

approval.regulator: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
approval.basis: Listed under BETAHISTINE DIHYDROCHLORIDE in the MHRA products database (medicines with a UK marketing authorisation).
